title: Setup
text: Opt roadmap page built open GitHub milestones issues (PRs, closed milestones issues labelled internal*, wontfix invalid skipped; closed issues go last). Customize roadmap.overrides.milestones / roadmap.overrides.issues (keyed milestone/issue number; take title description, issues also take order, milestones can add cards, title, description, optional url optional order). Cards ordered issue number closed issues last, unless set order; custom cards come last unless set roadmap.exclude.labels / roadmap.exclude.issues. See defaults package’s config. introduction (roadmap.intro) closing section (roadmap.outro) Markdown {package} {repo} placeholders, can replace . timeline generated latest GitHub release open milestones, milestones listed next release first, ordered version (milestones whose title version come last). GHA generates roadmap article (vignettes/articles/roadmap.Rmd, roadmap.qmd format: qmd) adds navbar link . article rewritten every build, add .gitignore. local builds use pkgdownconfig::build_site() place pkgdown::build_site(); forwards arguments. Plain pkgdown::build_site() add navbar link hide article, roadmap enabled fails sites define articles sections. roadmap fetched GitHub API build time. GHA uses token; local builds set GITHUB_PAT, otherwise GitHub’s unauthenticated limit 60 requests per hour applies build can fail.
